title: Contribution déterminée au niveau national de Djibouti (CDN de Djibouti), version révisée
organization: Republic of Djibouti, Ministry of Environment and Sustainable Development; UNFCCC repository
temporal_coverage: Revised NDC implementation period 2024–2030; climate projections to 2050 and longer-term risks.
methodology: Revised government NDC reports climate-risk analysis and adaptation commitments.
limitations: French-language policy estimates; some scenarios are unspecified.

title: Djibouti Country Climate and Development Report
temporal_coverage: CCDR summary presents projections to 2050 and mid-century.
methodology: World Bank Group CCDR country page with substantive report summary, risk estimates, and priority recommendations.
limitations: The linked full report was not inspected; claims are confined to the opened CCDR summary page.

title: Djibouti: Climate Action Can Protect Growth and Build Resilience
temporal_coverage: CCDR press release summarizes long-term climate risk through 2050 and current coastal-city exposure.
methodology: World Bank Group press release summarizing the first Djibouti CCDR and its priority risks.
limitations: Press-release summary, not the full CCDR; model assumptions are not included in the release.

title: Analyse de l’insécurité alimentaire aiguë et de la malnutrition aiguë, mai–décembre 2025
temporal_coverage: Current acute food insecurity May–June 2025; projection July–December 2025; response coverage January–May 2025.
limitations: Dated multi-driver analysis; forecasts depend on assumptions.

title: The Republic of Djibouti: Country Brief
organization: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations, Global Information and Early Warning System
temporal_coverage: Rainfall and pastoral conditions March–May 2025; food-security projection July–December 2025.
methodology: GIEWS country brief summarizes weather, rangeland and food-security monitoring for the reference date.
limitations: A dated situation snapshot; seasonal forecasts and projected food-security outcomes are not observed results.

title: Integrated Community Resilience Project (P506969), Project Appraisal Document
temporal_coverage: Country context and refugee figures as of January 2025; appraisal and proposed project activities in 2025.
limitations: Appraisal context and planned investments, not evaluated impact.

title: Sustainable Management of Water and Rangeland Resources for Enhanced Climate Resilience of Rural Communities in Djibouti
temporal_coverage: Six-year adaptation project listed as under implementation; page states intended results and target population.
methodology: UNDP project page describes locations, climate risks, institutional needs and planned activities.
limitations: Planned outcomes and targets are not evidence of completed delivery or independently measured impact.
